title: ICMPv6: add Expert Info for invalid ND-family Hop Limit
description:
# Summary

Wireshark correctly dissected ICMPv6 Neighbor Discovery-family packets, but it did not notify the user when the IPv6 Hop Limit violated the RFC requirement that it be 255.

This MR adds an Expert Info warning for affected ICMPv6 message types when the IPv6 Hop Limit is not 255, improving protocol analysis without changing packet dissection.

Because this validation also applies to packets generated by `text2pcap`, the MR includes a follow-up change to generate RFC-compliant dummy IPv6 Hop Limits **only for the affected ICMPv6 message types**, while preserving the existing default for unrelated IPv6 traffic.

# Details

The validation applies to the following ICMPv6 message types:

* Router Solicitation
* Router Advertisement
* Neighbor Solicitation
* Neighbor Advertisement
* Redirect

It also applies the same validation to the related ICMPv6 message types already identified by the existing FIXME (RFC 3122 and RFC 3971).

The implementation only adds protocol validation reporting using IPv6 header information already available to the ICMPv6 dissector. Packet parsing and decoding behavior are unchanged.

The accompanying `text2pcap` change generates an IPv6 Hop Limit of 255 only for the ICMPv6 Neighbor Discovery, Inverse Neighbor Discovery, and SEND Certification Path message types that require it, while preserving the existing default Hop Limit of 32 for all other IPv6 traffic.

# Testing

Added regression tests verifying that:

* the new Expert Info field is registered;
* valid Router Solicitation packets do not trigger the warning;
* invalid Router Solicitation packets correctly generate the Expert Info warning; and
* the `text2pcap` IPv6 regression tests continue to pass, confirming that ND-family ICMPv6 packets now use a compliant Hop Limit while unrelated IPv6 protocols are unaffected.

commits_data.title: text2pcap: generate compliant Hop Limit for ND-family ICMPv6 packets
commits_data.message:
text2pcap: generate compliant Hop Limit for ND-family ICMPv6 packets

text2pcap generates dummy IPv6 headers with a default Hop Limit of 32.
For ICMPv6 Neighbor Discovery-family messages, this produces packets
that violate the requirements of RFC 4861, RFC 3122, and RFC 3971,
which require an IPv6 Hop Limit of 255.

Generate a Hop Limit of 255 only for Neighbor Discovery, Inverse
Neighbor Discovery, and SEND Certification Path ICMPv6 message types,
while preserving the existing default of 32 for all other IPv6
traffic.

This keeps generated packets RFC-compliant without changing the
behavior of unrelated IPv6 protocols.

Signed-off-by: Urval Kheni <kheniurval777@gmail.com>

commits_data.message:
ICMPv6: add Expert Info for invalid ND-family Hop Limit

RFC 4861 requires Router Solicitation, Router Advertisement,
Neighbor Solicitation, Neighbor Advertisement, and Redirect
messages to use an IPv6 Hop Limit of 255.

The ICMPv6 dissector already had access to the IPv6 Hop Limit
but did not report this protocol violation. Add an Expert Info
warning when the Hop Limit is not 255 for the affected ICMPv6
message types.

Also apply the same validation to the related message types
already identified by the existing FIXME (RFC 3122 and
RFC 3971).

Add regression tests for valid and invalid Router Solicitation
packets.

Signed-off-by: Urval Kheni <kheniurval777@gmail.com>
